summary: Unlock the potential of your projects with our Benefits Realization in Program Management Training. Enhance skills and drive successful outcomes today!
lede: A benefits realization plan links program components to intended business outcomes and sets out how to measure and sustain them. For program, portfolio, PMO, business case, and change professionals, this course covers benefits mapping, KPI and baseline setting, and transition planning. Participants practice building a benefits register and reporting variances to support governance and ongoing ownership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with programs, portfolios, PMOs, business cases, or change initiatives and need to prove that delivered outputs create measurable benefits. Program Managers responsible for benefits delivery and sustainment. PMO Analysts preparing benefits registers and executive reports. Portfolio Coordinators aligning benefits with investment decisions. Business Case Owners defining expected outcomes and value. Change Managers supporting adoption and operational transition. Project Sponsors reviewing benefit claims and escalation decisions. Benefits Managers maintaining tracking and ownership models. Program Analysts compiling baseline, variance, and dashboard data. Operations Leads receiving program outputs into business-as-usual. Transformation Leads linking delivery work to strategic outcomes.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and a current or recent program example if available. Familiarity with program governance, business cases, or benefits reporting will make the exercises more relevant, but no specialist software installation is required.
